model_name: CycloneShield Multi-Hazard Exposure & Risk Engine (P-CHMVM v2.4)
target: Infrastructure Vulnerability & Multi-Hazard Exposure Index (Ground-truth structural failure labels unavailable in raw archives)
ground_truth_source: UNAVAILABLE (DFO FloodArchive provides macro-event polygons; individual building structural failure logs do not exist in public raw repositories)

baseline_comparison.composite_model_advantage: Multi-criteria fusion integrates 30m JRC surface water raster, hourly ERA5 wind gusts, SLOSH coastal surge, and asset backup power readiness, preventing severe false negatives for inland low-elevation substations.

limitations: Ground-truth post-disaster building tag inspection logs are not available in open datasets.
Supervised ML accuracy is deliberately set to null to avoid circular validation on pseudo-labels.
JRC Global Surface Water raster reflects historical recurrence rather than real-time flash flood hydrographs.
Backup power status for non-hospital assets is inferred based on criticality tier.
